div.div: مُرَجَّمٌ A narrative, or story, of which one is not to be made to know the real state: (S, K, TA:) or, as in some of the copies of the S, of which one knows not, or will not know, whether it be true or false: (TA:) or respecting which conjectures are formed. (Ham p. 494.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
